Transcript entry shape (measured 2026-10-17): one JSON object per line; type=='user' for a turn; timestamp is ISO-8601 UTC with a trailing Z (e.g. '2026-10-17T21:00:12.345Z', parsed by datetime.fromisoformat after Z->+00:00); origin is an optional dict whose kind is 'human'|'peer'|'task-notification'; entrypoint is 'cli'|'sdk-cli'; isMeta optional bool; message.content is a string or a list of blocks, a block {type:'tool_result'} marking a tool result.
